dataset.description: Five-day synthetic security logs with CloudTrail and Okta event outcomes; this evaluation uses deterministic 100-error + 100-recent samples from each file.
dataset.citation: beaaaaaan, Synthetic Security Logs V1, Kaggle, 2026.
dataset.normalization: All original CSV columns retained as strings, including empty cells. Dots in column names replaced by __; original-to-normalized key mapping saved per case. No field selection or truncation.

cases.task: 巡检 AWS CloudTrail 事件：优先列出 AccessDenied/错误事件，引用 eventID 或 requestID；再总结近期成功事件，区分可见样本与源文件全量。
